title: Improved cross-section navigation in public docs
points: The docs now use a single section-flow navigator that shows the intended reading path across overview, pipeline, engine, database, design choices, and changelog.
Changelog pages now show a bridge back to the docs section the reader came from, plus quick links to the main explanatory sections.
Docs tab navigation now participates in browser history so back and forward move through docs sections instead of trapping readers in one view.
Direct browser visits to docs and admin app paths now fall back to the app shell, so shared links do not depend on first loading the home page.
